subject: NOC turnaround data for the Q3 operations review
body:
Dear Layla, dear Faisal,

For the Q3 operations performance review, please share the NOC request and issue dates per master developer for all gated-community applications (MN-03, MN-06, MN-08) by Tuesday 6 October. Circular 14/2026 asks master developers to issue NOCs within 7 working days; we need to show where we stand against that.

Thank you,
Hessa Abdulla Al Suwaidi
Director, Digital Transformation Office

subject: Salary certificate validity — talking points for CHC agents
body:
Dear Sara,

Since 1 September, salary certificates for housing applications must be issued within the last 30 days (Circular 9/2026, item 4.4). Older certificates are treated as missing and stop the file. Could the agents remind callers of this before they upload documents?

Regards,
Khalfan Mohammed Al Ali
Senior Case Officer, Housing
